view_note: Eight serial projects (2,160 MW) sit ahead of the Hoodoo Wash–Yuma cluster. The six at Hoodoo Wash 500 kV need only switchyard work, except Q310's $4.8M loop-in of the Hassayampa–N.Gila 500 kV line, which Q332's NRIS also depends on. All real system upgrades sit at Yuma: Q350 at Orchard 230 kV carries $49.2M of upgrades (a second N.Gila 500/230 kV transformer, a second Orchard–N.Gila 230 kV line, a Yucca phase shifter and WAPA Gila transformer replacements), and Q297 carries $1.1M of 69 kV work for grid charging.
full_note: The serial block puts about $55M of system upgrades ahead of the cluster, almost all of it Q350's Yuma 230/69 kV package, which later reports treat as base-case. Cluster projects at Hoodoo Wash and North Gila are studied on top of these serial upgrades and the Hassayampa–N.Gila loop-in, so their own triggers start above the 2,160 MW of serial capacity.
